For a church service, I recommend a bright laser projector with at least 5,000 ANSI lumens, especially if you'll display worship lyrics, Bible verses, sermon slides, and videos while the sanctuary lights are on.

The most important features are brightness, readable text, quiet operation, and reliable HDMI connectivity.
